checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: ~10s vertical video with intelligible English voice-over
must.why: Vertical 480x854 and ~10s, but the audio was never heard; the assistant admits it didn't check.

must.item: Narration explains sound reflects off a surface and returns
must.why: Narration wasn't transcribed. The model generated it from instructions and it may not match the script.

must.item: Visuals show sound traveling from source to surface and back toward listener
must.why: Rings only go outward from the child, to the left and away from the wall. The rock wall is behind the child. Rings never visibly bounce off it or return. By the end they fade and the child fills the frame.

must.item: Simple child-friendly language, finishes without cutoff
must.why: The script is kid-friendly, but the spoken audio and its ending can't be verified.

must.item: Visual journey and spoken explanation agree
must.why: The script says the sound bounces off rock and returns. The visuals show only an outgoing burst and then a close-up of the child's face.

faults.what: No visible reflection or return of the sound waves, which is the core of the explainer
Waves travel away from the wall rather than toward it. The wall sits behind the child, not in front.
The camera pushes into a big close-up of the face and the waves fade away, so the concept is lost.
The child's face looks slightly warped and blobby in the 1s frame, and the character shifts in scale and pose.
Audio was never verified. The narration may not match the script. The separate voice-over failed to attach.

summary: The bright 3D cartoon canyon is attractive, but the waves only go outward and never bounce back, and the narration is unverified, so the echo explanation fails.
